steps.title: Establish the shared app architecture and platform foundations
steps.summary: From November 2026 to February 2027, establish the minimum shared architecture, hosting, identity, navigation, telemetry and service foundations needed for the King’s Edge replatform and a thin Student Experience Hub home.

outputs.title: Thin-Hub architecture blueprint
outputs.summary: Define the September 2027 common-home proposition and shared platform boundary.

outputs.title: Shared application foundations
outputs.summary: Establish hosting, identity, common shell, telemetry, assurance and live-service patterns needed by Edge and the Hub.

existingCapacity.contribution: Provide architecture authority, Azure and DevOps expertise, identity design and platform engineering.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: The Edge replatform and Hub home may lack an agreed, supportable foundation.

existingCapacity.owner: Digital and IT with 1.2 Data Foundations and Student Systems
existingCapacity.contribution: Advise on authoritative sources, available interfaces, security, privacy and accessibility, with deeper integration limited to what the first release needs.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: The team may over-engineer interfaces or create avoidable coupling.

newInvestment.item: Year 1 Student Experience Hub platform and delivery costs
newInvestment.fundingRoute: TBC through the mobilisation business case
newInvestment.rationale: Retains the existing envelope for Azure, environments, tooling and targeted specialist support. It must be validated against the thinner first-release scope and should not assume bespoke integration projects for timetabling, KEATS or Ask King’s. Staffing is held under 4.1.3.
newInvestment.riskIfMissing: The shared app foundations and Edge replatform may lack the platform services or specialist support needed for safe operation.

enablingConditions.condition: Validate the £90,000 envelope against the confirmed thin first-release scope before treating it as a committed cost.
enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: The business case may carry costs that no longer reflect the actual first-year design.

steps.title: Confirm the minimum first-release access patterns
steps.summary: From September to December 2026, confirm the simplest safe and useful way for the Hub to represent King’s Edge, timetabling, KEATS and Ask King’s. Default to existing feeds, widgets, authenticated hand-offs or deep links rather than bespoke integration.

outputs.title: First-release access decisions
outputs.summary: Record the September 2027 pattern, owner and material constraint for each of the four domains.

outputs.title: Minimum September scope
outputs.summary: Confirm what the Hub contains and what remains in each authoritative source service.

existingCapacity.owner: Digital and IT with the Student Experience Hub sponsor
existingCapacity.contribution: Confirm available interfaces and the simplest viable access pattern for each source.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: The team may over-engineer the first release or discover constraints too late.

existingCapacity.owner: King’s Edge, timetabling, KEATS and Ask King’s owners
existingCapacity.contribution: Provide documentation, available interfaces, planned changes and named decision makers.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: The Hub may be designed around incorrect assumptions.

enablingConditions.condition: Treat King’s Edge as the only first-year domain requiring substantial new product functionality; the other three domains default to the lightest useful access pattern.
enablingConditions.owner: Student Experience Hub sponsor and product owner
enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: The Hub may expand into several parallel integration projects.

enablingConditions.condition: Only deepen a non-Edge integration where an existing interface makes it straightforward and the student value is clear.
enablingConditions.owner: Student Experience Hub product owner with Digital and IT architecture
enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: Effort may be absorbed by unnecessary integration depth.

steps.title: Prototype the thin common student home
steps.summary: From November 2026 to April 2027, test increasingly realistic versions of the shared home, focusing on navigation, information hierarchy and useful hand-offs.

outputs.title: Common student-home prototypes
outputs.summary: Test progressively realistic versions of the thin shared home.

outputs.title: Evidence-led build refinements
outputs.summary: Translate proportionate student testing into a focused first-release backlog.

existingCapacity.contribution: Design and test the common home as part of the core team’s work, using extra research support only where needed.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: The Hub may become a set of links without a coherent experience.

steps.title: Build the shared Hub shell alongside King’s Edge
steps.summary: From January to June 2027, build the common home, identity, navigation, profile and telemetry while the deeper King’s Edge product develops under 4.1.4. Add only the light-touch timetable, KEATS and Ask King’s access needed for the first release.

outputs.title: Reusable Hub shell
outputs.summary: Build the common home, navigation, profile and telemetry.

outputs.title: Deep King’s Edge entry
outputs.summary: Place the substantive Edge experience within the shared student-home structure.

outputs.title: Light-touch service access
outputs.summary: Add the agreed timetable, KEATS and Ask King’s routes.

existingCapacity.contribution: Build the common shell and light-touch service routes alongside the King’s Edge roadmap.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: The Hub work may stall or displace committed Edge delivery.

enablingConditions.condition: Any proposed deeper non-Edge integration must make its capacity trade-off against King’s Edge explicit.
enablingConditions.owner: Student Experience Hub sponsor and 4.1.3 product leadership
enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: The broader Hub ambition may silently consume Edge capacity.

steps.title: Test the working Hub with students and service owners
steps.summary: From March to June 2027, test the working common home with a bounded but varied student cohort and relevant service owners, focusing on usefulness, clarity, accessibility and hand-offs.

outputs.title: Working student-home test
outputs.summary: Use real product evidence to refine navigation, content and hand-offs without widening scope.

steps.title: Lock the September first-release scope
steps.summary: By the end of June 2027, confirm the minimum September scope and resist additions that would turn the thin Hub into several new integration projects.

outputs.title: September scope lock
outputs.summary: Confirm the common home, King’s Edge and light-touch service-access scope.

steps.title: Complete proportionate launch readiness
steps.summary: During July and August 2027, complete the security, privacy, accessibility, performance, monitoring, support and release-readiness work appropriate to the actual first-release scope.

outputs.title: Launch-ready first release
outputs.summary: Complete proportionate assurance and support checks for the thin Hub.

steps.title: Launch the first Student Experience Hub
steps.summary: Launch in September 2027 with a shared student home, King’s Edge as the substantive native experience, and clear light-touch access to timetabling, KEATS and Ask King’s.

outputs.title: September 2027 first Hub release
outputs.summary: Make the common home available with King’s Edge and the three agreed service routes.

outputs.title: Usage and navigation baseline
outputs.summary: Measure whether students use the Hub as a useful starting point and where hand-offs work or fail.

steps.title: Operate, learn and decide where deeper integration is worth it
steps.summary: From September 2027 to February 2028, use live evidence to improve the common home and identify where deeper integration creates enough student value to justify additional effort.

newInvestment.item: Year 2 Student Experience Hub platform and delivery costs
newInvestment.fundingRoute: TBC through the mobilisation business case
newInvestment.rationale: A planning envelope for live platform consumption and targeted technical work, to be reset against actual first-release consumption and the evidence-based post-launch roadmap.
newInvestment.riskIfMissing: Necessary live operating or targeted technical costs may compete with the product roadmap.

steps.title: Approve the deeper app roadmap and first end-to-end non-Edge journeys
steps.summary: From March to April 2028, use live Hub evidence, journey research and learning from King’s Edge to select the first non-Edge areas that should move beyond access and hand-off into deeper integrated journeys.

steps.title: Deepen the shared app with the first end-to-end non-Edge journeys
steps.summary: Build the first selected deeper journeys into the existing student home, connecting authoritative data and CRM-enabled interactions where ready.

newInvestment.item: Year 3 Student Experience Hub platform and delivery costs
newInvestment.decisionNeededBy: Before the 2028/29 app and platform plan is fixed
newInvestment.fundingRoute: TBC through the mobilisation business case
newInvestment.rationale: Covers the larger live platform footprint and targeted integration, migration, assurance and transition costs that cannot be absorbed internally.
newInvestment.riskIfMissing: The wider app integration and transition may not be completed or operated safely.

steps.title: Expand integrated journeys and common app capabilities
steps.summary: Add further priority journeys and mature common search, actions, communications, notifications, personalisation, self-service and system integration.

steps.title: Make wider student journeys the primary product roadmap
steps.summary: Shift the centre of product demand towards the broader student experience and integrate additional systems and service journeys.

steps.title: Consolidate the Hub and rationalise parallel entry points
steps.summary: Establish the Student Experience Hub as the primary student-facing product and progressively rationalise duplicated entry points where continuity is assured.

newInvestment.item: Business-as-usual Student Experience Hub platform operating costs
newInvestment.category: recurrent digital app and platform costs
newInvestment.estimatedCost: Indicative £60,000 annual recurrent envelope in constant 2026 prices.
newInvestment.decisionNeededBy: Before recurrent budgets are fixed for 2029/30
newInvestment.fundingRoute: Recurrent Digital and IT baseline, TBC
newInvestment.rationale: Covers production platform operation and limited tooling and specialist technical support that cannot be absorbed elsewhere.
newInvestment.riskIfMissing: The Hub may lack the operating budget required to remain secure, reliable and supportable.
